paragraphs: Dear Hiring Manager, I am a Software Engineering graduate applying for the Platform Engineer opportunity at Neumo. I am particularly interested in Neumo because the Platform team builds shared services that power multiple government applications, allowing engineers to create reusable solutions with broad impact. The opportunity to work across React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL while learning a complex domain and contributing to software used by communities strongly aligns with my interests in full-stack engineering and continuous learning.

My experience closely matches the technical foundation required for this role. At VCap, I engineered a full-stack e-commerce prototype using Next.js, React, Prisma, PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare Workers, designing a relational database with 11 interconnected entities and implementing 14 REST API endpoints covering catalog, cart, order persistence, and WhatsApp checkout workflows. I also validated all 14 endpoints with Postman and used Claude, GitHub Copilot, and Kimi K3 as development assistants while critically reviewing generated code. At SShare, I engineered a Node.js backend ticket-management system with authentication, role-based access control, CRUD functionality, relational database architecture, API testing, and Git/GitHub workflows. At Clever Cloud, I optimized SQL queries for a Java-based POS platform, improving execution performance by 60%, while also contributing to CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.

I bring experience working remotely and collaborating through Agile practices including Scrum, Kanban, and Extreme Programming, with hands-on exposure to pair programming, continuous feedback, Git-based workflows, and API testing. My approach emphasizes writing maintainable code, validating implementations through testing, investigating problems methodically, and using AI tools as productivity aids while maintaining responsibility for the quality of the resulting code. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my full-stack experience, problem-solving mindset, and willingness to learn could contribute to Neumo's Platform team. I would be glad to schedule an interview at your convenience.
